F(x,y)=\bigl(2F(x,y)-1\bigr)(1-x)(1-y)
      \Longrightarrow  F\bigl[1-2(1-x)(1-y)\bigr]=-1 .
\]

Hence

\[
F(x,y)=\frac{1}{2(1-x)(1-y)-1}
      =\frac{(1-x)(1-y)}{1-2x-2y+2xy}.
\tag{5}
\]

--------------------------------------------------------------------
### 4.  Evaluating the required sum

The double sum in the problem equals \(F\bigl(\tfrac1{10},\tfrac1{10}\bigr)\).

\[
\begin{aligned}
F\!\left(\frac{1}{10},\frac{1}{10}\right)
&= \frac{(1-\frac1{10})^{2}}
        {1-2\!\left(\frac1{10}\right)-2\!\left(\frac1{10}\right)
          +2\!\left(\frac1{10}\right)^{2}}   \\[2mm]
&= \frac{\left(\frac{9}{10}\right)^{2}}
        {1-\frac{2}{10}-\frac{2}{10}+\frac{2}{100}}   \\[2mm]
&= \frac{\frac{81}{100}}{\frac{31}{50}}
 = \frac{81}{62}.
\end{aligned}
\]
